adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is built with `toLowerCase()` (env split + map), but the filter compares `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` using the raw `guest` string, so different-cased inputs (e.g. `Blocked@Domain.com`) will not match the lowercase blacklist and can bypass it. The duplicate-prevention check `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` is also case-sensitive, so a same email with different casing (e.g. `Alice@x.com` vs existing `alice@x.com`) would be treated as “unique” and added again. Both behaviors are directly verifiable from the shown filter logic.
